### Repository canonical YAML snapshot (`repository-state`)

Create with `uv run rig snapshot create`. Embeds automatically in `uv run rig backup create`.

Notes: Dated full-rig configuration snapshot of data/*.yaml (RIG-016).

### Ableton PFL jam template / set (`pfl-jam-ableton-set`)

Point paths.pfl_jam_ableton_set in `.rig.local.yaml` at the Live Set or project file, then run `uv run rig backup create`.

Notes: Template location + version/date should be documented once restored once.

### Controller mappings export (`controller-mappings`)

Export Launchpad, Launch Control 3, padKONTROL, FCB1010, ZeRO SL, and related mapping files from each editor/device. Optionally set paths.controller_mappings_export if a collected folder exists.

Notes: Prefer external archive path; do not dump large binaries into git.

### Stream Deck+ profiles (`stream-deck-profiles`)

Notes: No OBS websocket automation in Stage 11.

Notes: Sampling/monitor path is separate from clean TASCAM captures.

### U6MIDI Pro route configuration (`u6midi-routes`)

## Commands

```bash
uv run rig backup plan
uv run rig backup status
uv run rig snapshot create
uv run rig backup create --output /path/to/archive
```

`rig snapshot create` captures canonical `data/*.yaml`. `rig backup create` embeds a snapshot and copies configured FILE_COPY / DIRECTORY_COPY items; MANUAL_EXPORT items are reported for operator action.

Broad `--snapshot-before` integration on mutation commands is deferred; use `uv run rig snapshot create` manually before risky changes.
